integrity: Exact block enumerator, finite-length mean and variance, and Gaussian limit are proved in RESULT.md; finite standard-library checks are supplementary; no independent audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The limit law is for complete blocks of length \(4^L\), not arbitrary cutoffs. The binary-carry valuation formula and zero-valuation characterization were established in prior work. Priority may be affected by unindexed literature.
title: Exact dyadic valuation distribution and Gaussian law for 3-central binomial coefficients
